content: Official Blossom specs define public content-addressed blob retrieval plus Nostr-authenticated upload/delete/mirror/media operations. Current hzrd149 blossom-server supports auth, size/type/retention rules, per-pubkey scoping, reports, admin UI, local/S3 storage and deletion. Pyramid has member-only uploads, per-member limits, self-delete and operator management. Retrieval is public by default, so access-controlled rooms cannot safely attach plaintext private files; client-side encryption is needed. Flotilla currently encrypts file bytes and passes decryption tags inside NIP-17 DM events, but this does not make NIP-29 room attachments E2EE.
